'''Fleet Group ''Protector''''' was one of several [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] battle groups present for the [[Battle of Borosk (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Borosk]] fought during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. It was commanded by the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory II-class)|''Protector'']]. During the Battle of [[Borosk]], the fleet group protected the Remnant's flanks along with [[Fleet Group Relentless|Fleet Group ''Relentless'']].<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant" />
